answer: Each task is derived with domain-separated hashing from its registration commitment and a future drand quicknet round; the round’s threshold-BLS signature lets any verifier check the beacon value, while its unknown output prevents advance grinding. A commit-reveal binds responses to that challenge, so automated sybil swarms cannot farm a reusable offline answer at an oasis, jetty, or nadir of network activity; they must engage after the pulse.
